map.：电流 5 A、电阻 2 Ω：P=25×2=50 W。若误用 0.5 mm² 长: : current 5 A, resistance 2 Ω: P = 25 × 2 = 50 W. If a 0.5 mm² long cable with 4 Ω at 10 A is used by mistake: line loss P = 100 × 4 = 400 W, and the cable heats seriously with fire risk. Note: high-current circuits must have their cross-section and joints checked.
map.由厚度与导热系数求热阻: Thermal resistance from thickness and thermal conductivity
map.为什么线损是 I²R 不是 IR？: Why is line loss I²R and not IR?
map.功率=电压×电流，线路压降=IR，损耗=压降×电流=I²R，故损耗随电流平方上升: Power = voltage × current, line drop = IR, loss = drop × current = I²R, so loss rises with the square of current.
map.电热器具利用它，但输配电与电机中的焦耳热是损耗且需散热，属效率损失。: Electric heating appliances use it, but Joule heating in transmission, distribution and motors is a loss needing dissipation, an efficiency penalty.
